items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: Well, Armand P. Ron, the best violinist right down in New Orleans, he was. And he could play jazz.

ctx.x: Well, Armand P. Ron, the best violinist right down in New Orleans, he was. And he could play jazz. Him of course. He'd play any kind of music. He was a complete musician. But one thing that you can't shake like my sister Kate, that's Louie Armstrong's number.
That's what I heard too. Louie told me that.
